$comment: SEED / shape example only — NOT read at runtime. The live resolution chain is: <project>/.context-hub/workspace.json → ~/.config/tut/workspace.json (or $TUT_USER_CONFIG_DIR) → built-in defaults. To customize, copy this file to one of those locations (mkdir -p first) and edit; tut assign writes the project-level file. Placeholders in naming.tab_label: {role} {task} {agent}; the pane label stays the fixed <task_id>.<role> addressing key and is never templated. Legacy {label, agent} entries are tolerated on read (only .agent is read).
